name: skillseal
description: ONEST-compliant certification platform for corporate training programs

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @skillseal/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @skillseal/shared && npm run build -w @skillseal/api && npm run build -w @skillseal/web
scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run build -w @skillseal/shared && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
